name: playwright-ts-saucedemo-e2e
description: Enterprise-grade Playwright TypeScript E2E testing demo for Sauce Demo (Swag Labs)

scripts.test:bdd: npm run clean && bddgen && playwright test
scripts.test:headed: npm run clean && bddgen && playwright test --headed
scripts.test:ui: npm run clean && bddgen && playwright test --ui
scripts.test:debug: npm run clean && bddgen && playwright test --debug
scripts.test:chromium: npm run clean && bddgen && playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:firefox: npm run clean && bddgen && playwright test --project=firefox
scripts.test:webkit: npm run clean && bddgen && playwright test --project=webkit
